Turn on Audio sharing / Auracast in the Bluetooth screen that just opened, then come back and press Play. Friends join from the QR code your phone shows there.
Plug in or connect your Auracast transmitter, press Play, and have friends join its stream. The QR code shows the stream name and passkey.
Broadcasting directly. Friends pick this stream name in their Auracast menu and enter the passkey if set.
